purpose: Materialize a second fixed executable circuit program by compressing exact L13H8 pending-opener term interchanges to six ordered-closer displacement vectors and testing them prospectively on the still-closed OOD split.

prior_art_search.result: Exact per-prompt opener-term swaps transfer on FINAL_TEST, while pair-centered selective necessity fails because distance-extension controls are causally active. No artifact stores context-independent ordered-pair displacements or tests them on OOD.

program.keys: six ordered pairs among closer IDs 1, 8, and 60
program.vector: mean over SELECT target endpoints of exact donor opener-term minus recipient opener-term at projected L13H8 output
program.installation: add the selected fixed 1,152-D vector to the recipient L13H8 final-position write
program.control_dispatch: answer-preserving OOD families have identical pending closer IDs and dispatch the exact zero vector

predictions.pred_a_export_is_temporally_clean: Exactly six finite nonzero 1,152-D vectors (6,912 FP32 scalars) are exported from 144 SELECT target endpoints; zero OOD rows, activations, logits, or outcomes are consumed.
predictions.pred_b_ood_capability_and_instrument: Every OOD native family/side cell has accuracy at least 0.75; native replay error and zero-vector replay error are each at most 1e-4; all 144 target endpoint installations and 216 control zero dispatches occur exactly once.
predictions.pred_c_fixed_program_substitutes_exact_t: Across 144 OOD target endpoints, prototype donorward effects versus exact per-prompt term-swap effects have cosine at least 0.65, relative L2 error at most 0.90, sign agreement at least 0.75, and norm ratio in [0.25, 2.0].
predictions.pred_d_each_family_and_ordered_pair_recu: Each of two target families has cosine at least 0.50 and sign agreement at least 0.70; every one of six ordered-pair groups has at least 0.70 positive prototype donorward effects.
predictions.pred_e_control_and_price: All answer-preserving rows dispatch zero, change logits by at most 1e-4, and preserve answers; total export plus causal price is at most five model forwards, 1,584 example evaluations, zero backwards, fits, or parameter updates.

terminal_rule: program_screen if all gates pass; null if instruments/capability/export are valid but any transfer gate fails; invalid otherwise.
closed_claims: selective necessity of the exact opener term
cross-program composition before this program passes
